event: Amendment 3 (2026-08-10): the first scored run executed all 100 audits under the frozen code and archived every raw output, then crashed in harness plumbing BEFORE any metric was computed or seen (KeyError between the in-memory run dict and the on-disk archive envelope). The harness was fixed; the re-run scored the ORIGINAL archived outputs without re-executing any audit.
sealing_note: This marker was committed retrospectively during completion review to seal the already-exercised allowance. The freeze manifest rerun_allowance.consumed field is the second, independent record; either record alone makes the harness refuse any further rerun. No further rerun of audit_claimset_v1 is permitted.
